Design.evidence_source: [page/88/Text/0] Participants then face two more decisions, the order of which was randomized. These two decisions may provide some insight related to how participants make decisions in the Known Information condition, but participants only ever make these decisions after they make decisions in the Hidden Information condition, so these latter two decisions could be influenced by their decisions in the Hidden Information condition.

Sample.evidence_source: The first decision described is a third-party decision game, not a dictator game for the participant. The subsequent decisions (Decision 2 and 3) are dictator games for the participant, but they represent an aligned state (selfish option for dictator benefits recipient) rather than a conflict state (selfish option harms recipient) as defined for this meta-analysis. Therefore, no relevant conflict state dictator game data is present for extraction.
